youtube.title: The Eiffel Tower Grows In Summer 🗼 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The Eiffel Tower is taller in summer than in winter.

It's made of iron, and iron expands when it gets hot. On the hottest days, the tower can grow by up to about fifteen centimetres. And because the sun heats one side more, the top leans slightly away from it. In winter, the cold shrinks it back down. It does this every single year. A tower that breathes with the seasons.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
